final: WITH g AS (SELECT z.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(s.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / s.spanmin) AS grp_avg FROM scans s JOIN sites z ON s.zoneref = z.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY z.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scans, g.grp_avg, g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg
